# PARADOX

> PARADOX is an independent AI video production studio. It makes cinematic brand films, AI-generated video ads, music videos and original characters for brands, agencies, artists and small businesses, worldwide. Every project is quoted individually, includes one revision round, and all imagery is openly labelled as AI-generated.

## Services
- [AI video production for brands and agencies](https://paradox-ai-creatives.pages.dev/ai-video-production-company/): brand films, AI commercials, social video ads, white-label agency work
- [AI video ads for small businesses](https://paradox-ai-creatives.pages.dev/ads/): 6 to 30 second ads for products, restaurants, property, apps and local services
- [AI music videos](https://paradox-ai-creatives.pages.dev/ai-music-video-creator/): music videos, visualizers and vertical cuts for artists and labels
- [AI character design and concept art](https://paradox-ai-creatives.pages.dev/ai-character-design/): original characters with reference sheets, world concept art
